title: A ticket names the model its work runs on
intention: Every ticket names the model its work runs on, opus by default, so a single ticket can be pointed at haiku or fable without changing any other.
why: Akien 2026-10-11: "we should add 'model' to tickets and the default should be opus" — so a deep Fable review of a strategic point, or a quick Haiku file sweep, can be one ticket's choice (idea 2026-10-11-we-should-add-model-to-tickets-and).
traces_to: Law 1 (which model a ticket needs is settled once, at the cast, not re-derived by each builder); Telos cost discipline: the cheapest capable model per piece of work.
how: 'model' joins plan_fields in CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json; transitions.cast_ticket stamps model='opus' when absent and refuses a value outside {haiku, sonnet, opus, fable}; a reader ticket_model(doc) in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py returns doc['model'] or 'opus' for the tickets cast before the field (no backfill); skills/sail/SKILL.md step 2 says: when ticket_model differs from the builder's own model, the build runs in an Agent spawned with that model.
falsifier: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_ticket_names_its_model.py under PROVES {'2cee2c5e8478': {'1','2','3','4'}}, against a scratch tickets_dir with its own charter: (1) a cast without 'model' is written with model 'opus'; (2) a cast with model 'fable' keeps it; (3) a cast with model 'gpt' is refused with a lack naming 'model'; (4) ticket_model({}) == 'opus' and ticket_model({'model':'haiku'}) == 'haiku'. Hollow: the old cast_ticket (no stamp, no check) reds 1 and 3; removing ticket_model reds 4.
watchme: none, because the field is a cast-time contract whose break is caught by the proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_ticket_names_its_model.py at every reseal; whether per-ticket models are worth it is the review Akien set for after all tickets close, idea /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/ideas/2026-10-11-we-should-add-model-to-tickets-and.json

decisions.text: Allowed values are the Agent tool's model names: haiku, sonnet, opus, fable; anything else is refused at the cast. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
Tickets cast before the field are not rewritten; ticket_model reads an absent field as opus (memory backfill-writes-beside-without-reading). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
Changing a cast ticket's model rides the artifact door like any plan edit; no new verb. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
This ticket's own model is opus. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
'model' joins plan_fields in CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json, inserted right after 'workflow_and_state', written through the artifact door (verb cast). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
decisions.step: add model to plan_fields in the store charter

decisions.text: skills/sail/SKILL.md step 2 gains one bullet: read transitions.ticket_model(doc) and, when it differs from the builder's own model, spawn the build through the Agent tool with model=<that value>; otherwise build inline. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
decisions.step: update sail step 2 to spawn builds on the ticket's model

decisions.text: plan_fields is a flat JSON list of key-name strings; 'model' is the bare string "model" placed right after "workflow_and_state", with no schema object. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
The SKILL.md bullet matches step 2's existing bullets: a '- **bold lead** —' sentence naming transitions.ticket_model(doc) and the Agent tool's model parameter. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

In cast_ticket, beside the existing lacks checks and the 'cast' date stamp: an absent model is stamped 'opus'; a present one is folded with system_word.canon over (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) and stored folded; anything else adds a lack naming 'model' and the value, so the cast is refused. The docstring's 'Touches no key of doc but cast' gains 'and model'. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
decisions.step: Modify cast_ticket in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py to stamp model='opus' when absent and refuse values outside {haiku, sonnet, opus, fable}

decisions.text: transitions.ticket_model(doc) returns the folded model of a ticket dict, or 'opus' when the key is absent or empty; it never raises on an unknown value (it returns it), and it sits beside cast_ticket. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
decisions.step: Write ticket_model(doc) function in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py returning doc.get('model', 'opus')

decisions.text: The proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_ticket_names_its_model.py is written before BUILDME and stands red first, with 4 teeth under PROVES {'2cee2c5e8478': {'1','2','3','4'}} as the falsifier lists. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
